answer.explanation: My 14:00 note for the dining tabletop (v056) lists a white wine glass. The picture I kept confirms it: a white wine glass stands at the left edge of the table, next to the vase, orchid, bowl and gold tray.

In the 22:00 island picture there is a small orange tapered object on the right side of the counter, near the blue/black tub. My notes call it an 'orange pencil', but in the image it is shaped like a small carrot. The red item by the green bottle is a sausage, not a carrot.
In my 20:00 picture of the bathroom 1 vanity top, there is a yellow pump-top bottle next to the tissue box. It looks like a hand soap dispenser. My note logged it as a 'yellow bottle'.

In my 16:00 picture of the entryway floor (v073), there is a pair of short, dark grey/black boots near the door. They look glossy, like rubber, so they appear to be rain boots. My note lists them as 'black boots', and the same pair shows up at other times as 'grey boots'. I'm only fairly sure they are rain boots rather than ordinary ankle boots. Also there: red sneakers, a lime green backpack and a white stick.

In my 12:00 picture of the island (v033), a small, flat red rectangle lies at the back left of the counter, beside the white canister and a thin orange stick that my notes call an 'orange pencil'. It looks like a small notebook. The same red item shows in the 10:00 picture (v017) and is gone at 14:00 (v049). The object is small and far away, so I am only fairly sure it is the field notebook.

At 20:00 on day 4 the picture of the nightstand shows a lamp, a white mug, a dark brown wallet, a white charger with its cable, a white bottle, a blue 'Cool London' book and a small green-and-purple block. There is no black or green glass phone. The green-and-purple block sits in the same spot in the 08:00 picture and looks like a block, not a phone. My note for 20:00 also lists no phone.

My 16:00 note (v079) lists only a yellow bottle, a white tissue box and toilet paper rolls. The picture shows more: a small white tube with a red cap lying on top of the tissue box, above the yellow pump bottle. It looks like a toothpaste tube, so the answer is yes. The tube is small in the picture, so this is a best reading of the image.

My 12:00 note for the desk top leaves out the water bottle, but the picture I kept from that patrol (v043) shows a dark water bottle standing next to the monitor, behind the tablet. It matches the black water bottle in my 08:00 and 10:00 notes (v011, v027), and the 12:00 entry recorded no changes.

My note for 12:00 on the island countertop lists a 'yellow object'. In the picture I kept (v033), that object is a small, long, curved yellow item lying flat behind the stacked bowls, next to the blue bottle. Its shape and colour match a banana. It is small and far back in the picture, so I am fairly but not fully sure.

My 18:00 picture of the countertop by the range (v085) shows a tall green glass bottle with a pourer spout and a label next to the brown shaker, the egg and the chip bag. It looks like an olive oil bottle. My notes list it as a 'green bottle', which appeared there at 14:00 and stayed.

My 14:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor shows a small black zippered case with an orange zipper pull near the back, beside the light blue pants and the plaid sock. My notes called it a 'black box', but in the picture it looks like a toiletry bag. The same item is in my notes at every visit that day.

I have a picture of the vanity at 14:00 on day 6 (v063). It shows a tissue box, a yellow pump bottle and toilet paper rolls. There is also a small white object with a red tip, and I don't think it is toothpaste. The 22:00 picture shows the same kind of white-and-red object, and there it is clearly a toy airplane model. My notes for 14:00 don't list toothpaste either.

At 16:00 on day 3, my note for the bathroom 2 floor lists dark patterned socks and light blue socks. In the picture, the dark patterned sock has a chunky knit look, like a wool sock. It sits near the black glasses and black box. The light blue item looks more like jeans than a sock.

In the 10:00 picture (v021) there is a spatula lying on the countertop by the range. It has a black handle and a flat, slotted grey head. My note called it a 'black-handled knife', but the picture shows a spatula. I can't be fully sure from the image that it's silicone and not metal, but a spatula was there.

My 20:00 note (v101) calls the red item a 'red carrot', and other patrols called it a 'sausage' or a 'pepper'. In the picture it looks like a red silicone spatula head: a flat red blade, with what looks like a hole near the tip, attached to a black handle. It is standing up behind the cutting board, next to the wooden spoon. The labels keep changing, which suggests the earlier names were wrong. This is a judgement from one unclear picture, not a certain match.

In the 18:00 picture (v083) there is a slim black cylinder with a domed cap beside the faucet. It has the same shape as the black glass thermos in the 08:00 picture (v003). The 10:00 picture (v019) is identical, and my notes for it list the thermos. Later notes called this object a 'black soap dispenser', but it looks like the thermos, so a thermos was there.

My 08:00 note for the dining table on day 5 (v008) lists a white wine glass. The note also says the glass had moved there since the last patrol. The table notes from later patrols that day also list the wine glass.

At 16:00 (v069) the green bottle on this counter is plainly an olive-oil bottle with a black spout and a copper ring. In the 22:00 picture (v117) that same black spout and copper ring stick up behind the white paper on the cutting board. The 22:00 picture is identical to the 20:00 one (v101), whose note lists the green bottle. So the olive oil was there, mostly hidden behind the paper.

My 12:00 picture of the left cooktop (v036) shows only a black two-handled frying pan/braiser, a small dark canister, a large orange egg-shaped object and a patterned bag. There's no saucepan. A saucepan with a long handle first shows up in the 14:00 picture (v052), in the spot where the canister was at 12:00. The 10:00 picture (v020) looks the same as 12:00, with no saucepan.

My 08:00 note for the bedroom 1 floor on day 4 (v014) lists only a black sock and a silver shoe. In the picture I see a silver flat shoe, a small dark sock or slipper near the doorway, and a dark sock-like item in the bottom-left corner. There are no lounge pants on the floor.

At 12:00 on day 5 I photographed the left cooktop. My note lists white crumpled paper, a white cylindrical container, a blue vase, an orange item and a patterned bag. When I opened the picture, I saw no ladle on the cooktop.
My 08:00 note for the office desk top on day 3 (v011) lists a black water bottle. The kept picture agrees: a water bottle with a dark cap stands behind the monitor, next to the tablet.

My 10:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor (v032) shows white tops and t-shirts, a grey hoodie, light blue jeans, black shorts, a belt, a white sneaker, an orange boot, glasses and a black bag. The only long pants are the light blue jeans, which look like denim, not sleep pants. Nothing in the picture looks like sleep pants.

In my 18:00 picture of the office desk (v091), small strips of white printed paper lie near the front-left edge of the desk, and there is a small white slip to the left of the keyboard. They look like receipts, and my note for that visit lists 'white paper'. These slips were not there in my 10:00 picture (v027). I am fairly confident but not certain that they are receipts.

My 08:00 note on day 3 for the dining table tabletop (v008) lists a white wine glass, next to the gold tray, the dark grey ribbed vase with white orchids, a dark grey bowl and plates. Every later patrol that day also noted the wine glass there.

The 14:00 picture of the countertop by the range shows a green oil bottle, a small white garlic/egg-like object, a wooden pepper grinder, a spatula and a bag of chips. There are no canned tomatoes in it, and my note for that visit lists none either.

At 08:00 on day 5 my note for the countertop by the range lists only a brown cylindrical container, a white egg and a yellow-and-white bag. The kept picture shows the same: a wooden pepper-mill-like container, a white egg and a chip bag. No wooden spoon is in the picture.

My 08:00 note for the bedroom 1 floor (v014) lists only a black sock. I opened that picture: the only thing on the floor is a soft, dark, fabric item that looks like a sock. I see no clogs or other kitchen shoes, so the answer is no.

My 10:00 note for the office desk top on day 3 lists a white keyboard, white mouse, silver monitor, white tablet, dark water bottle, red apple and white mug, with no wallet. The kept picture shows the same things: a monitor, keyboard, tablet, dark bottle, apple and mug. There is no wallet on the desk.

At 18:00 on day 7 my note for the bedroom 1 floor lists a brown potted plant, a blue ottoman, red flowers and the white floor. The kept picture matches that note, and it shows no lounge pants or any other clothing on the floor.

My 12:00 note for the island (v033) lists a brown egg, blue/white bottle, white towel, green bottle, blue/black tub, yellow food and white powder. It lists no notebook. In the 12:00 picture I see the same things. There is also a long, flat black object behind the yellow food, which my earlier notes call a 'black rectangle'. It does not look like a field notebook, so I'm answering no, though I'm not fully sure what that black object is.

My 10:00 picture of the countertop beside the sink shows a tall black insulated drinking bottle standing at the sink edge. My note called it a 'black glass thermos', but it looks like a water bottle. The orange bottle next to it is detergent. I can't say whose it is: it isn't Mara's clear steel bottle or Julian's brushed steel thermos.

I photographed the left cooktop at 16:00 on day 3 (v068). It showed a white bowl, the black cooktop, red knobs, a green bottle, a black pot, a white candle and a small blue object. When I opened the picture, the blue object looked like a little bird figurine, and v116 later notes a blue bird figurine there. I could not see a silicone spatula anywhere in the picture.

At 14:00 on day 5 the dining tabletop held a white wine glass, a dark grey ribbed vase, a white orchid, a dark grey bowl and a gold tray. The picture shows only one glass, and it has a stem, so it is a wine glass, not a water glass. No water glass or tumbler is visible.

My 18:00 note on the sink basin (v082) lists a blue and white bottle, a white plate, a black cylindrical object, a paper towel roll, an orange bottle and a white towel. No mug is listed. In the picture, the black cylinder is a tall bottle-shaped object, not a mug, and there is no mug anywhere in or beside the basin.

My 14:00 note for bathroom 2's floor (v064) doesn't list a dress, but the picture shows one. At the bottom edge there is a white garment, partly cut off, with two shoulder straps and a scooped neckline, so it looks like a white sleeveless dress. Later notes called it a 'white towel'. It is in the same spot in the 08:00 picture (v016). The rest of the floor: light blue jeans, a black bag, a plaid sock, white boots, glasses and green camo pants. Because the garment is cut off, it could also be a white top.

My 08:00 note for the island countertop lists a black rectangle, silver pillow, white powder and orange pencil. The picture shows a large black object, a gold/silver bag behind it, scattered white powder and a small orange item. I see no olive oil bottle. The black object does block part of the counter, though.

My 08:00 note for the dining tabletop on day 6 lists a gold tray, a wine glass, a ribbed vase with orchids, a dark bowl and a blue and white plate. When I opened that picture, I saw no honey jar anywhere on the table.

At 18:00 on day 7 my note for the island countertop lists only a green plant in a white pot; everything else had been cleared off. I opened the picture and it shows a bare countertop with just the potted plant. There is no menu folder.

I have a picture of the island at 16:00 on day 5. It shows a mug, a bowl, a towel, a green bottle, a tub, a banana-like yellow object and a dark object, but no carrot. My note says an 'orange stick' appeared. In the picture it looks like a small sharpened orange pencil, and my usual notes for the island list an 'orange pencil'. The orange round thing behind the bowl is not a carrot either.

At 22:00 on day 6 my note for the left cooktop lists a white bowl, a black frying pan and a black pot. The picture I kept shows pans and a pot on the cooktop and a white bowl at the edge. There are no carrots.

The 14:00 picture of the left cooktop shows a white bowl, the black gas cooktop, a black pot, a green bottle, a white candle and the red knobs. No canned tomatoes are visible, and my note for that time doesn't list any either.

My 20:00 note for the countertop beside the sink (v099) lists a white crumpled cloth, a white paper towel roll, the black glass thermos and the orange detergent bottle. The picture matches this and shows no bowl on the countertop. The brown speckled bowl seen at 08:00 had already gone by 10:00. The white round item in the basin is the white plate recorded at the sink basin, not a bowl on the countertop.

The 10:00 day 5 note for the island countertop (v017) lists a white mug, a tub, a bowl, a towel, a green bottle, an egg, a plate and a small yellow object. It lists no notebook. The picture I kept matches the note: towel, bowls, plate, bottle, egg, mug, tub and a small yellow item. No notebook is visible.

My 12:00 note for the nightstand lists a lamp, white mug, dark brown wallet, charger, cable, white bottle, blue book and a green/purple box, with no keys. The kept picture matches: no keys are visible. A red key was there at 08:00, but it was no longer listed by 10:00.

My 20:00 note for the entryway floor (v105) lists only red sneakers, black boots and a white stick. The kept picture matches that: there is no jacket on the floor, so no denim chore jacket or any other jacket.

In the 20:00 picture of the countertop beside the sink, a tall black insulated bottle stands near the sink. My note calls it a 'black glass thermos'. It is a drink bottle (a vacuum flask), so a water bottle was there. The orange spray can, towels, and bowl were also there.

My note for the 10:00 day 4 patrol of the bedroom 1 floor lists only a black shoe and a black sock. When I opened that picture, the only thing on the floor was a small dark item that looks like socks or a shoe. There is no cardigan or other larger piece of clothing.

My 12:00 picture of the dining table (v040) shows only a white stemmed wine glass, a dark grey ribbed vase with a white orchid, a dark grey bowl and a gold tray. I saw no water glass or tumbler. The only glassware was the stemmed wine glass.

My 16:00 note for the island countertop (v065) lists a white/blue carton, silver pillow, black pot, white towel, black basket and blue/black tub, and no banana. In the picture I kept, I can see a milk carton, a silver bag, the plant, a black basket with folded towels, and a bottle. There is no banana in the picture.

My 20:00 picture of the mattress (v109) shows a stack of books lying on the duvet. My 22:00 picture (v125) shows no books on the bed at all, even though my note for that visit says two were still there. The mattress notes list the book stack at every visit from 08:00 through 20:00, so the paperback was taken off between 20:00 and 22:00.

At 08:00 there was a green olive-oil bottle on the left cooktop (v004, and visible in the picture). By 10:00 it was gone: the note says 'green bottle gone' (v020), and the picture shows only pots and pans on the cooktop.

My notes never list spoons here, so I checked the pictures. At 08:00, 14:00 and 18:00 there is no spoon. At 22:00 a thin silver spoon lies on the left of the counter by the sink. At 20:00 a folded white towel covers that same spot, so the spoon could have been under it. The towel was moved away by 22:00, which is when the spoon first shows. My best answer is between 20:00 and 22:00, but 18:00 to 20:00 is possible if the towel was hiding it.

At 08:00 (v003) a blue-and-white patterned plate sits at the left end of the countertop beside the sink. At 10:00 (v019) the notes say it is gone. The picture agrees: a coffee tin, bowl and chip bag now fill that end and the patterned plate doesn't show. The tin hides part of that spot, so the picture alone can't fully rule the plate out. No plate is noted on that countertop at any later patrol.

In the 08:00 picture (v001), an open laptop sits on the island countertop; my notes called it the 'black rectangle'. It looks dark because the lighting is dim. In the 10:00 picture (v017), the same view shows a yogurt cup, a chip bag, a basket, a green bowl and a silver bag, but no laptop. The laptop is also missing in the 12:00 and 14:00 pictures, so it was taken between 08:00 and 10:00.

The 18:00 picture (v081) clearly shows a large brown egg on the island beside the green bottle. In the 20:00 picture (v097) that spot is empty and no egg is visible, even though the 20:00 note lists an 'orange egg'. The 22:00 picture (v113) also shows no egg. So the egg was taken off between 18:00 and 20:00.

My notes never say 'receipt', so I checked the pictures. A flat white paper slip, likely the receipt and noted as 'white powder', lies on the island at 08:00 (v001) and 10:00 (v017). At 12:00 (v033) it is still there, moved to the middle. At 14:00 (v049) it is gone, and the notes for that visit also say 'white powder gone'. It is still missing at 16:00 (v065) and 18:00 (v081).

There is no egg on the left cooktop in the 20:00 picture (v100). The 22:00 picture (v116) shows a large brown egg on the cooktop, which my note listed as an 'orange sphere'. At the same patrol, my note for the countertop by the range (v117) says the brown egg there was gone. So the egg was put on the cooktop between 20:00 and 22:00.

I take the water glass to be the item my notes call the 'white ribbed cup'. The pictures from 16:00 and 18:00 show it on the coffee table. It is gone in the 20:00 picture, although my 20:00 note wrongly still lists it. At 20:00 a white ribbed cup shows up on the dining table, so it was probably moved there.

There is no egg on the left cooktop in the 08:00, 10:00, 14:00 or 18:00 pictures. Those show the pot, the paper bag, an orange sausage-like item, the white roll and the blue vase. The 20:00 picture shows a large brown egg in front of the cooktop, together with a frying pan and a canister that also appeared then. My note called the egg an 'orange sphere'. So the egg was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

The large brown egg is on the countertop by the range in every patrol from 08:00 through 20:00, and the 20:00 picture (v101) shows it clearly. In the 22:00 picture (v117) the egg is gone and a yellow chip bag is there instead. The 22:00 note says 'brown egg gone' but also lists one under 'now'. The picture settles it: the egg is not there.

The 08:00 picture (v012) shows a key with a black fob and a red key on the nightstand, next to the lamp base. The 10:00 picture (v028) shows the same place without the keys. The notes for 10:00 and later list no key either.

There is no olive oil bottle on the island in the 08:00 picture (v001). In the 10:00 picture (v017), a green glass bottle with a cork, which looks like olive oil, is standing on the island. My note for that patrol records a green bottle appearing there. At the same time, the green bottle that had been on the left cooktop at 08:00 was gone by 10:00.

None of my bathroom 2 floor pictures show a shirt being taken. A white shirt (probably the restaurant shirt) is in the same spot at 08:00, 10:00, 14:00, 16:00 and 22:00. Between 14:00 and 16:00 the blanket and rainbow sock moved, and some small white bits at the bottom edge of the picture were gone. Those bits are too partial to call a shirt, so I can't say when, or whether, a restaurant shirt was taken off this floor.

My notes never mention a spatula here, so I checked the pictures. At 08:00, 14:00, 16:00 and 18:00 the counter has only the shaker, egg, green bottle and chip bag. At 20:00 a long, thin utensil with a black handle is lying flat at the left side of the counter. It appeared along with the big brown egg, the silver canister and the white bowls, and it is still there at 22:00. It is most likely the silicone spatula, though in the picture it could also pass for a knife.

The 14:00 picture of the countertop beside the kitchen sink (v051) shows no thermos, only the brown bowl, the faucet, the dish rack and the orange can. The 16:00 picture (v067) shows a black thermos standing next to the sink. So it was put there between 14:00 and 16:00. It is still there at 18:00, 20:00 and 22:00.

In the 18:00 picture of the desk top there is a monitor, keyboard, mouse, tablet, apple and bottle, but no laptop. In the 20:00 picture a small open laptop with a lit screen sits to the left of the monitor, so it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

In the 18:00 picture of the countertop by the range there is no egg. The 'white egg' in my notes is really a tipped-over white bowl, next to the shaker, green bottle and chip bag. In the 20:00 picture a large brown egg has appeared, so it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

The 18:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor (v096) has no black and white dress on it. The 20:00 picture (v112) shows the dress near the lower middle of the floor. It is still there at 22:00 (v128). So the dress was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

In the 08:00 picture of the island countertop (v001) there is no egg. In the 10:00 picture (v017) a large brown egg is in the middle of the counter, and my note for that patrol says 'brown egg appeared'. The egg stays there in every later patrol that day, so it was put there between 08:00 and 10:00.

My notes never mention a sleep shirt, so I went by the pictures. At 08:00 (v014) a dark grey cloth that looks like a garment is lying in the bottom-left of the bedroom 1 floor. By 10:00 (v030) it is gone. The black pair that was near the sofa at 08:00 is now in the middle of the floor, and it stays there until it leaves between 20:00 and 22:00 (v110, v126). So the grey garment is most likely the sleep shirt, and it was taken between 08:00 and 10:00.

The 10:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor shows a grey hooded top (a hoodie) lying on the lower left. The 12:00 picture shows no hoodie: that spot is taken by the camo pants, a white top and other things. The 14:00 picture looks the same as 12:00. So the hoodie was taken between 10:00 and 12:00.

In my 10:00 and 14:00 pictures of the bathroom 2 floor there is no grey hoodie. The things on the floor then were the blanket, white sneaker, light blue pants, orange boot, camo pants and socks. In my 16:00 picture the floor items have been moved around, and a grey hoodie is lying at the lower left. It is still there at 18:00. So it was put down between 14:00 and 16:00.

The 16:00 picture of the coffee table (v070) shows no tin. In the 18:00 picture (v086) a small brown tin has appeared. Its label is too blurry to read, but it is smaller and looks different from the tin marked 'COFFEE' that is there at 20:00 and 22:00 (v102, v118). That makes the 18:00 tin most likely the tea tin, so it was put there between 16:00 and 18:00.

The 08:00 picture of the left cooktop shows a silver saucepan with a long handle next to the black braiser and the black stockpot. In the 10:00 picture the saucepan is gone. The braiser, a small bowl, an orange sphere and the stockpot are still there, and no saucepan or handle can be seen.

In the 08:00 picture (v003), a brown speckled bowl sits beside the sink. In the 10:00 picture (v019), the bowl is gone and only mugs, the orange bottle and the faucet remain. The bowl does not appear there in any later patrol.

In the 18:00 picture the sink basin holds the coffee tin, the bowl and a white plate, and no dark pan is visible. In the 20:00 picture a dark round pan, which looks like a cast iron skillet, sits in the basin under the speckled mug. The 22:00 picture still shows it. My notes did not name a skillet, so this answer comes from the pictures.

There is no carrot in the 16:00 picture of the countertop by the range (v069). It shows a green bottle, an egg, a grinder, a spatula and a chip bag. The 18:00 picture (v085) shows an orange carrot on the new wooden cutting board, which my note there mislabeled as 'red sausage'. In the 20:00 picture (v101) it is still on the board. So the carrot was put there between 16:00 and 18:00.

The 18:00 picture of the sink basin shows no saucepan, just a plate, bottles, a paper towel roll and a towel. The 20:00 picture shows a dark lidded saucepan sitting in the basin. The 12:00 and 14:00 pictures don't show one either. So it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

My notes for the left cooktop list an 'orange sphere' at 08:00, 10:00 and 12:00. The 12:00 picture (v036) shows this is a large brown egg on the cooktop. At 14:00 the note says the orange sphere is gone, and the picture (v052) shows pots and pans there instead, with no egg.

answer.doing: Making dinner: a cutting board, a carrot or sausage, a wooden spoon or chopsticks and a black cup were set out next to the knife, oil bottle, egg and chip bag. She was chopping and cooking a meal.
answer.explanation: The 16:00 picture shows only the oil, grinder, egg, tongs and chips. The 18:00 picture adds a cutting board, a carrot, a wooden spoon and a cup, so someone was preparing food. None of either person's things are in the pictures, so the 'who' comes from their schedules. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30, and Mara gets home around 17:30. The cooking continued at 20:00, and a fork and cup appeared on the dining table at 20:00, which fits Mara making dinner at home.

answer.doing: Breakfast was finished and cleared. The plate of food was taken away, then an egg and a bottle of oil were put out to cook something, probably eggs on the stove.
answer.explanation: At 08:00 there was a breakfast plate of white food on the island. By 10:00 the plate and food were gone, and a brown egg and a green oil bottle had appeared. In the same window a frying pan and a pot appeared on the cooktop. No personal belongings were left, so this is a guess. Julian is the likely cook: he is a chef who cooks a lot at home and doesn't leave until about 09:30. Mara usually leaves around 08:30.

answer.doing: Someone ate a meal at the dining table. A white cup, a second cup at the left edge and a dark fork were set out, and the wine glass was moved next to a plate on the far side. This came after cooking at the range between 16:00 and 20:00.
answer.explanation: At 18:00 the table held only the tray, vase, bowls and wine glass. By 20:00 there were cups and a fork, and the wine glass had moved to a plate, which looks like dinner. The range counter was in use for cooking at 18:00 and 20:00. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30. Mara is usually home after about 17:30, so she most likely ate here. The two cups could mean a second person, so this is a guess.

answer.doing: Probably changing clothes, swapping one outfit for another. The boots and sneaker that were there before are gone, and new clothes (camo pants, a grey top) were dropped on the floor. This fits getting ready for the evening restaurant shift.
answer.explanation: The 14:00 and 16:00 pictures show an outfit swap. The orange boot, white sneaker and white boots are gone. Two dark camo-patterned pants and a grey hooded top appeared. The light blue pants, blanket, black glasses and black box were moved. None of these items are on the people sheet, so the person is a guess from timing: Julian is usually home about 14:30-16:30 between shifts, so changing before going back fits him. Mara may also have been home (the desk changed too), so I'm not sure.

answer.doing: Making breakfast or prepping food. A yogurt cup, a milk carton, a snack bag, a banana, a black basket and a green bowl were set out on the island, and a cutting board appears in the background.
answer.explanation: At 08:00 the island held only a dark box-like object, a crinkled bag and some spilled white powder. By 10:00 there were food items and bowls on it. In the same two hours a frying pan showed up on the cooktop and a knife and tongs showed up on the counter by the range, so someone was cooking across the whole kitchen. Julian cooks a lot at home and usually leaves around 09:30, so he most likely made breakfast before going. No personal belongings on the island show who it was.

answer.doing: Someone set up a meal on the range: they took away the large egg (the 'orange sphere') and put a big black stockpot and a small saucepan on the burners. It looks like cooking or getting ready to cook.
answer.explanation: At 12:00 the cooktop had a frying pan, a small container and a large egg. By 14:00 the egg was gone and a tall black stockpot and a saucepan were on the burners. That's a cooking setup. People never show up in my pictures, and nothing personal was left behind. Julian is a chef who cooks a lot at home, so he is the likely cook. He may have come home a little before his usual 14:30. This is a guess, not something I saw.

answer.doing: Probably changing clothes or sorting a pile of clothes: someone picked up the dark camo-green pants and one white top, moved the black bag with the orange handle and a sock, and dropped an orange umbrella on the floor.
answer.explanation: The 20:00 and 22:00 pictures show the green pants and one white top gone, the black bag moved to the top right, and an orange umbrella newly on the floor. Nothing here matches either person's listed things, so I am going on schedule alone, and that is a weak guess. Julian is usually at the restaurant from 16:30 to 23:30, so Mara is the one most likely home at this hour.

answer.doing: Making a hot drink, probably coffee, after getting home and then washing up. The coffee tin and white canister were put away, a used mug went into the sink, and a cloth and black thermos were left on the counter.
